035package org.jfree.chart.geom;
036
037import java.awt.geom.Point2D;
038
039/**
040 * The {@link Point2DNumber} class defines a point that avoids rounding errors
041 * by referencing the original {@link Number} types.
042 */
043public class Point2DNumber extends Point2D {
044    /**
045     * The X coordinate of this <code>Point2D</code>.
046     */
047    public Number x;
048
049    /**
050     * The Y coordinate of this <code>Point2D</code>.
051     */
052    public Number y;
053
054    /**
055     * Constructs and initializes a <code>Point2D</code> with the specified
056     * coordinates.
057     *
058     * @param x the X coordinate of the newly constructed <code>Point2D</code>
059     * @param y the Y coordinate of the newly constructed <code>Point2D</code>
060     * @since 1.2
061     */
062    public Point2DNumber(Number x, Number y) {
063        this.x = x;
064        this.y = y;
065    }
066
067    @Override
068    public double getX() {
069        return x == null ? java.lang.Double.NaN : x.doubleValue();
070    }
071
072    @Override
073    public double getY() {
074        return y == null ? java.lang.Double.NaN : y.doubleValue();
075    }
076
077    @Override
078    public void setLocation(double x, double y) {
079        this.x = x;
080        this.y = y;
081    }
082
083    /**
084     * Sets the location of this <code>Point2D</code> to the specified
085     * {@link Number} coordinates.
086     *
087     * @param x the new X coordinate of this {@code Point2D}
088     * @param y the new Y coordinate of this {@code Point2D}
089     */
090    public void setLocation(Number x, Number y) {
091        this.x = x;
092        this.y = y;
093    }
094
095    @Override
096    public int hashCode() {
097        final int prime = 31;
098        int result = 1;
099        result = prime * result + ((x == null) ? 0 : x.hashCode());
100        result = prime * result + ((y == null) ? 0 : y.hashCode());
101        return result;
102    }
103
104    @Override
105    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
106        if (this == obj)
107            return true;
108        if (obj == null)
109            return false;
110        if (getClass() != obj.getClass())
111            return false;
112        Point2DNumber other = (Point2DNumber) obj;
113        if (x == null) {
114            if (other.x != null)
115                return false;
116        } else if (!x.equals(other.x))
117            return false;
118        if (y == null) {
119            if (other.y != null)
120                return false;
121        } else if (!y.equals(other.y))
122            return false;
123        return true;
124    }
125
126    @Override
127    public String toString() {
128        return "Point2DNumber[" + x + ", " + y + "]";
129    }
130}
